mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected future dividends and thereby depressing S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-tightening period (p > 0.05) or the discount rate sensitivity estimate is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% in a month is associated with increased consumer caution, lowering expected corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
regime_hint: Early stage of labor market recovery
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in 70% of similar low-unemployment episodes (rolling IC > 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in consumer spending (HOUST) above 0.5% YoY signals resilient demand, which elevates earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns under high-HOUST months are not statistically superior to a baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of at least 2% in a month indicates weakening manufacturing capacity, which reduces growth expectations and yields negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for two consecutive months below previous month's value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of analogous INDPRO contraction episodes (rolling IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be negative due to expectations of rate hikes and reduced growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) during such inflation episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in job openings (not directly observable in the provided catalog, but as a proxy via complement variables) is captured by a decline in UNRATE; this signals labor market tightness that boosts investor confidence and produces positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by >0.2% in a month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20-day windows following such UNRATE declines (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly acceleration in retail sales ( proxy via HOUST > previous month's level by >5%) predicts higher corporate profit expectations and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during flat or declining HOUST months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) remains below trend for two consecutive months, it reflects persistent supply-side constraints that depress growth forecasts and drive negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO below trend for two consecutive months (estimated via rolling mean)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not persistently negative across similar episodes (IC > 0.15).
